profile.name: LIU Yuhang
profile.title: PhD Student at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University

about: I am a PhD student in the Department of Computing at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU), advised by Prof. Hongxia Yang. Previously, I received my M.S. degree from Zhejiang University, where I was advised by Prof. Shengyu Zhang. My research focuses on Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM Agents, with particular interests in Agentic Post-training, Reinforcement Learning, Tool Use, and Reasoning.

My previous research focused on multimodal GUI agents, including InfiGUIAgent, InfiGUI-R1, and InfiGUI-G1, with an emphasis on enabling agents to move beyond reactive action generation toward deliberative reasoning, reflection, and robust interaction. Building on this line of work, I am now exploring general-purpose LLM agents that can reason, use tools, and adapt in complex interactive environments.

publications.title: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
publications.authors: Yuhang Liu*, Zeyu Liu*, Shuanghe Zhu, Pengxiang Li, Congkai Xie, Jiasheng Wang, Xavier Hu, Xiaotian Han, Jianbo Yuan, Xinyao Wang, Shengyu Zhang, Hongxia Yang, Fei Wu. (*Equal contribution)
publications.idea: Introduces Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization (AEPO) to address inefficient exploration in GUI grounding, helping RL overcome high-confidence errors and learn challenging semantic associations.

publications.title: InfiGUIAgent: A Multimodal Generalist GUI Agent with Native Reasoning and Reflection
publications.authors: Yuhang Liu, Pengxiang Li, Zishu Wei, Congkai Xie, Xueyu Hu, Xinchen Xu, Shengyu Zhang, Xiaotian Han, Hongxia Yang, Fei Wu.
publications.idea: Develops a multimodal generalist GUI agent with native reasoning and reflection through a two-stage training pipeline that strengthens GUI understanding and equips the agent for complex interaction without textual annotations.

publications.title: InfiGUI-R1: Advancing Multimodal GUI Agents from Reactive Actors to Deliberative Reasoners
publications.authors: Yuhang Liu*, Pengxiang Li*, Congkai Xie, Xavier Hu, Xiaotian Han, Shengyu Zhang, Hongxia Yang, Fei Wu.
publications.idea: Proposes Actor2Reasoner, a two-stage framework combining reasoning distillation and reinforcement learning to transform reactive GUI actors into more deliberative reasoners with stronger planning and error recovery.

publications.title: Infi-MMR: Curriculum-based Unlocking Multimodal Reasoning via Phased Reinforcement Learning in Multimodal Small Language Models
publications.authors: Zeyu Liu*, Yuhang Liu*, Guanghao Zhu, Congkai Xie, Zhen Li, Jianbo Yuan, Xinyao Wang, Qing Li, Shing-Chi Cheung, Shengyu Zhang, Fei Wu, Hongxia Yang. (*Equal contribution)
publications.idea: Uses a phased reinforcement-learning curriculum to progressively activate textual reasoning, transfer it to multimodal settings, and reduce linguistic bias in multimodal small language models.

publications.title: Fine-Grained Guidance for Retrievers: Leveraging LLMs' Feedback in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
publications.authors: Yuhang Liu, Xueyu Hu, Shengyu Zhang, Jingyuan Chen, Fan Wu, Fei Wu.
publications.idea: Introduces FiGRet, which uses fine-grained LLM feedback on relevance, comprehensiveness, and purity to better align retrievers with downstream generation preferences.

publications.title: GUI-PRA: Process Reward Agent for GUI Tasks
publications.authors: Tao Xiong, Xavier Hu, Yurun Chen, Yuhang Liu, Changqiao Wu, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Shengyu Zhang.
publications.idea: Introduces a Process Reward Agent for GUI tasks that turns process evaluation from passive scoring into active investigation, enabling more reliable step-level judgments through domain-aware reasoning and active evidence gathering.

publications.title: From Parameters to Behaviors: A Survey of Model Fusion for Large Language Models
publications.authors: Shuo Cai, Yanggan Gu, Zihao Wang, Yuanyi Wang, Yibo Yan, Wenjun Wang, Yuhang Liu, Guanghao Zhu, Sirui Huang, Ming Li, Hongxia Yang.
publications.idea: Provides a unified view of model fusion for LLMs, organizing existing methods into parameter-, representation-, and behavior-level fusion while surveying evaluation, applications, challenges, and future directions.

publications.title: InfiR: Crafting Effective Small Language Models and Multimodal Small Language Models in Reasoning
publications.authors: Congkai Xie, Shuo Cai, Wenjun Wang, Pengxiang Li, Zhijie Sang, Kejing Yang, Yiming Zhang, Zhen Li, Guanghao Zhu, Zeyu Liu, Yang Yu, Yuhang Liu, Su Lu, Baoyi He, Qi Zhou, Xiaotian Han, Jianbo Yuan, Shengyu Zhang, Fei Wu, Hongxia Yang.
publications.idea: Presents a training recipe for building compact language and multimodal models with competitive reasoning capabilities, targeting efficient deployment under limited computational budgets.
